about:
Nile Automotive Tennessee, based in Tracy City, Tennessee, has operated since 1988 as a custom plastic injection molding supplier. The company is led by CEO and President NS Rao and began with a focus on delivering quality molded products for the automotive sector.

The company runs two ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 certified plants equipped with 30 injection molding presses ranging from 55 to 1,200 tons of clamping force. Its in-house capabilities cover insert molding, over molding, assembly, hot-stamping, sonic welding, hot-gluing, tape-sealing, painting, chrome plating, and hydro graphics, supported by design and project management for plastic component tooling. Value-added services include decorating, packaging, and logistics.

Nile Automotive serves the automotive, medical, agricultural, and industrial markets, shipping products worldwide from its southeastern U.S. locations. Customers range from OEMs requiring high-volume production to medical device manufacturers needing clean-room assembly.

The company states its differentiation lies in a commitment to continual improvement, a clean and safe working environment, ongoing machine technology upgrades, and rigorous tooling maintenance programs, all aimed at surpassing customer expectations for quality, on-time delivery, and price.
